## 设计
3 个横排面板，figure* 宽度（~textwidth）：

**(a) Formalization Pipeline**:
流程图：NL Input → LLM Formalizer → Formal Logic (FOL/Prolog) → External Solver (Prover9/SWI-Prolog) → Proved/Failed
用方框和箭头，简洁明快

**(b) STA Protocol**:  
示意：一个 proved formalization 有 n 个 components {c₁, c₂, ..., cₙ}
LOO: 去掉 c₁ → re-run solver → Failed ✓ (necessary)
去掉 c₂ → re-run solver → Proved ✗ (redundant)
...
ISR = n_necessary / n

**(c) ISR Dual Role**:
分叉图：ISR → 两条路径
路径 1: "Post-hoc Diagnostic" → ✓ Detects hacking (green check)
路径 2: "Training Reward" → ✗ Meta-level Goodhart (red X, with small annotation: "model games the diagnostic itself")

### B. Hacking Mode Definitions

1. H1 — Conclusion Embedding: 多前提中嵌入结论
2. H7 — Conclusion Duplication: 单前提 = 结论
3. Tautological Collapse: 双组件 P→P
4. Repetition Collapse: 重复至 token limit
5. Complexity-without-utility: 语法复杂但语义空
6. Contradiction Explosion: 组件数爆炸
7. Query-as-fact Gaming: NL→atom 同时作 fact 和 query（绕过 text-match classifier）

每种模式给一个简短的伪代码示例（FOL 或 Prolog 格式）。
